content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user of the to-do list","i_want":"to edit the title, description, priority and Due Date of an existing task","so_that":"I can correct or update my task details and keep the task list accurate","business_description":"Users can change the user-editable fields of a task after it is created. The same form used for creation is reused in edit mode with the current values filled in. The backend validates every change: the title must be non-empty and at most 100 characters, and the Due Date must not be earlier than the Creation Date. The Frontend shows a success state only after the backend confirms the update. Status is not changed by this story; it is changed through the status change capability in US-change-task-status.","business_value":"Users can fix mistakes and reflect changing plans without deleting and recreating tasks, which keeps the personal task list accurate and the report data current.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, a Description, a Priority of Low, Medium or High, and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to a non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, changes the Description, changes the Priority, changes the Due Date, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores all changed values and returns success, and only after that response the task list shows the new values and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"An update request is pending and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The user is waiting after submitting the edit form","then":"No success message is shown and the task list shows the old values for that task"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user enters a title of 101 characters and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An update request with a Priority value other than Low, Medium or High","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no stored data is changed"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated, shows no success message, keeps the form values for correction, and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no stored data is changed"},{"given":"An update request with a malformed body or a field of the wrong type","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error and no stored data is changed"},{"given":"An update request where the database fails during the write","when":"The backend processes the request","then":"The backend returns an internal server error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A successful task update","when":"The backend stores the updated task","then":"The Last Updated Date of the task is set to the time of the update"}],"edge_cases":["Creation Date is not listed as an editable field in the PRD; this story assumes it cannot be changed. Confirm with the product owner.","Status is not editable in this story; status changes are handled by US-change-task-status. Open question: whether the edit form should display Status as read-only.","A title made only of spaces: the PRD says non-empty but does not say whether spaces count. Open question; the team must decide and document the rule.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is allowed, because the rule only rejects dates earlier than the Creation Date.","Changing only the Due Date to a date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected even when the title is valid.","A title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; 101 characters is rejected.","The PRD does not state whether the Description has a length limit or is required. This story does not add one.","Editing a task that another request has deleted returns Task Not Found and the form shows an error."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint accepts title, Description, Priority and Due Date and stores them only after successful validation","Title non-empty and 100-character rules are enforced by the backend and reflected in the form error messages","Due Date not-earlier-than-Creation-Date rule is enforced by the backend and reflected in the form error message","Last Updated Date is set on every successful update","Task Not Found, invalid input, missing mandatory field and internal server error responses are returned as specified and leave stored data unchanged","The edit form pre-fills all editable fields with the stored values","The frontend shows success only after a successful backend response and never shows an optimistic update","Success and error messages are shown after every update action","Automated tests for the edit flow pass"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID covering title, Description, Priority and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the backend endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. It accepts Title, Description, Priority and Due Date. It validates that the title is non-empty and at most 100 characters, that Priority is Low, Medium or High, and that Due Date is not earlier than the stored Creation Date. It returns Task Not Found for unknown IDs, invalid input for malformed bodies or wrong types, missing mandatory field errors for an empty title, and an internal server error when the database write fails. It leaves stored data unchanged on any error and sets Last Updated Date on success. It uses the tasks table and fields created by US-create-task and does not add new fields.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-244669c0","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date for an existing task ID","Title empty returns a missing mandatory field error and leaves the stored title unchanged","Title longer than 100 characters returns a validation error and leaves stored data unchanged","Due Date earlier than Creation Date returns a validation error and leaves stored data unchanged","Priority outside Low, Medium, High returns an invalid input error","Unknown ID returns Task Not Found","Database failure returns an internal server error and leaves stored data unchanged","Last Updated Date is set on each successful update","Error responses follow the simple error handling approach used by the other task endpoints"]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with all editable fields pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the shared task creation and editing form in edit mode. Load the current task values and pre-fill Title, Description, Priority and Due Date. Submit changes to the update endpoint. Keep the form values when the backend returns an error so the user can correct them. Do not show the task as updated before the backend responds.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-bc3213df","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit mode opens with the stored values for Title, Description, Priority and Due Date","Status is not editable in the form","Submit sends only the update request and waits for the backend response","Form values are kept after a backend error","No optimistic update is shown before the backend confirms success"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-result-feedback","title":"[FE] Show success or error message after a task update without optimistic display","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"After each update action, display a success message when the backend confirms the update and an error message when it fails. On success, refresh the task list with the new values. On failure, show no success message and leave the list with the previous values.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Success message appears only after a successful backend response","Error message appears when the backend returns an error","Task list shows the old values while the request is pending and after a failure","Messages are shown after every update action"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API, database and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Create the automated tests for the edit flow. Cover the update endpoint with valid and invalid inputs, the database state before and after each rejected update, the edit form pre-fill and validation messages, the pending state, and the success and error feedback.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover a successful update of each editable field","Tests cover empty title, 101-character title, Due Date earlier than Creation Date, invalid Priority, unknown ID, malformed body and database failure","Tests confirm stored data is unchanged after every rejected update","Tests confirm no success message is shown while the request is pending or after an error","Test suite passes in the continuous integration pipeline"]}]}
